title: Letter on Sullivan's death sent to the FBI but never received

tellings.quote: And we I took we took that information. We've composed a letter, sent it to the FBI uh through the oversight committee only to later we we we had been told that it had been sent later we found out that it had never been received.

plain: A US congressman named Eric Burlison says that he and others put together a letter about the death of a man called Sullivan and sent it to the FBI through the House Oversight Committee, the congressional committee that watches over government agencies. They were told it had been sent, he says, but later learned it "had never been received." Burlison links the matter to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has spoken publicly about hidden UFO programmes, and to an Office of Inspector General, a government watchdog office, and tells it as a sign that such inquiries can quietly go missing.
